newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton ends slightly up in lackluster session.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton ends slightly up in lackluster session.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures closed a thinly-traded session up slighty, as the speculators covered short positions and put on new long positions by the close, market sources said.
Volume was estimated at only 5,000 lots, with most activity taking place late in the day.
The spot March contract ended 0.30 higher at 74.95 cents, traded 75.29 to 74.64. The back months settled 0.67 to 0.08 firmer.
Traders said prices should remained confined to the recent trading range amid a dearth of fundamental news. The U.S. Department of Agriculture will release its next crop estimate Feb 12.
